title: 遣悲怀·其二
author: 元稹
intro: A man mourns the wife who shared his years of poverty. Through her clothes, her sewing box and her old maid, he finds her everywhere — and ends with one of the most quoted lines in Chinese: for a poor couple, everything brings sorrow.
analysis: 这是元稹怀念亡妻的三首诗中的第二首，这类怀念死去妻子的诗叫“悼亡诗”。开头说：从前两人开玩笑，说起“谁先死了以后怎么办”，没想到今天全都成了眼前的事。中间四句全是生活小事：妻子的衣服已经送人，快送完了；她用过的针线盒还留着，却不忍心打开；因为念着她的旧情，对她身边的婢女仆人也格外怜惜；梦见她，醒来还给她烧纸钱。这些细节很普通，却让人看到他每天都在想她。最后两句说：我当然知道生离死别人人都会遇到，可我们是一起熬过贫贱日子的夫妻，回想起来，每一件事都让人心酸。“贫贱夫妻百事哀”原本是说这份特别的伤痛，今天常被借来说“穷夫妻事事难”，意思有了变化。
analysisEn: This is the second of three poems Yuan Zhen wrote for his dead wife — a kind of Chinese poem called 悼亡, “mourning the departed”. It begins with a memory: once, half-joking, the two of them talked about what would happen “after one of us dies”. Now all those jokes have come true in front of him. The middle four lines are made entirely of everyday details. He has been giving her clothes away, and they are nearly gone. Her needle-and-thread box is still there, but he cannot bear to open it. Because she was kind to her maids and servants, he treats them gently too. He dreams of her, and when he wakes he burns paper money for her, as people did for the dead. Nothing here is dramatic, yet every small act shows that she is on his mind all day. The last couplet says: of course I know everyone suffers losses like this — but we were a couple who lived through poverty together, so every memory hurts. That final line, 贫贱夫妻百事哀, is still quoted today, though people now often use it to mean “a poor couple fights over everything”, which is not quite what Yuan Zhen meant.
background: Yuan Zhen (779–831) was a Tang official and poet, and Bai Juyi’s closest friend. Around 802 he married Wei Cong, the daughter of a high official, who shared his early years of poverty; she died in 809 at the age of 27, just as his career was beginning to rise. He wrote three “Easing My Grief” poems in her memory.
pronunciation: 已施 shī（送给别人）；行看尽 的“行”读 xíng（将要），“看”读 kàn；婢仆 bì pú；夫妻 fū qī；衣裳 yī cháng（诗词逐字注音读 cháng，口语读 yīshang）。
version: 采用通行版本（如《唐诗三百首》所收）。第二句“今朝都到眼前来”的“都”，《全唐诗》一作“皆”。三首《遣悲怀》网站只收第二首，全诗完整。

lines.py: xī rì xì yán shēn hòu yì
lines.lit: In past days we joked about what would happen after death;
lines.en: Once we joked about “when one of us is gone” —

lines.py: jīn zhāo dōu dào yǎn qián lái
lines.lit: today it has all come before my eyes.
lines.en: now every word of it stands in front of me.

lines.py: yī cháng yǐ shī xíng kàn jìn
lines.lit: Your clothes are given away, soon to be all gone;
lines.en: I have given your clothes away; soon there will be none,

lines.py: zhēn xiàn yóu cún wèi rěn kāi
lines.lit: your needles and thread still remain; I cannot bear to open them.
lines.en: but your sewing box is still here — I cannot bring myself to open it.

lines.py: shàng xiǎng jiù qíng lián bì pú
lines.lit: Still thinking of old feelings, I am tender to the maids and servants;
lines.en: For your sake I am gentle with the servants you were fond of;

lines.py: yě céng yīn mèng sòng qián cái
lines.lit: and once, because of a dream, I sent you money.
lines.en: and once, after dreaming of you, I burned money for you to spend.

lines.py: chéng zhī cǐ hèn rén rén yǒu
lines.lit: Truly I know this sorrow everyone has;
lines.en: I know that everyone, sooner or later, loses someone —

lines.py: pín jiàn fū qī bǎi shì āi
lines.lit: but for a husband and wife who were poor and humble, a hundred things bring grief.
lines.en: but when a couple were poor together, every memory is grief.

words.note: 今天有“消遣”“排遣”；“派遣”是另一个意思。
书面语，今天也说“君无戏言”；口语说“开玩笑的话”。
古今同义，今天还说“身后事”。
今天有“施舍”；“施工”“措施”是别的意思。
古义，表示“将要”，现代汉语不这样用。
书面语，今天有“记忆犹新”；口语说“还”。

words.en: to burn paper money for the dead
words.note: 指烧纸钱给死者，这个风俗今天在清明等节日仍可见。
古义“确实”，今天多用“诚实”“真诚”的意思。
古义多指遗憾、悲伤，不同于今天“恨一个人”的“恨”。

words.en: for a couple who were poor together, everything brings sorrow
words.note: 今天常被引用，多用来说“没钱的夫妻样样难”，和原意不完全相同。

imagery.name: 线
imagery.zh: 妻子留下的针线是她勤劳持家的痕迹，留着又不敢打开，因为一打开就会想起她缝补的样子。
imagery.en: Her needles and thread are traces of the years she kept their poor home going; he keeps them but cannot open the box, because it would bring her back too clearly.

imagery.name: 梦
imagery.zh: 只有在梦里才能再见到妻子，醒来还要为她“送钱财”，梦成了生者和死者之间唯一的联系。
imagery.en: Only in dreams can he see her again — and he wakes to burn money for her, as if the dream were the one road still open between them.
